description: This file is a shell script designed to install host system binaries along with required libraries, with functions for copying, moving, creating symlinks, and patching binaries.

methods.name: _cp
methods.description: Copies a file with verbose option and error handling.

methods.name: _mv
methods.description: Moves a file with verbose option and error handling.

methods.name: _md
methods.description: Creates directories with verbose option and error handling.

methods.name: _ln
methods.description: Creates symbolic links with verbose option and error handling.

methods.name: _relpath
methods.description: Computes relative path between two directories.

methods.name: _runas_so
methods.description: Generates a shared object library to modify process argument zero.

methods.name: should_be_patched
methods.description: Determines if a binary should be patched based on its type.
